cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Can You Keep It?
cards.instruction: Use increasingly sensitive details to test whether someone deserves deeper trust.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The club's changing the menu. Keep that quiet before I tell you the bigger news.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Not even the person you tell everything to?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. We've found the first lock to check.

mechanism: A releases increasingly consequential club news while grading its pupil discretion and correcting revealing changes in behavior.
confusable: Not merely asking for silence once: A moves from menu change to chef departure to A involvement, making deeper trust conditional on B handling each clue.
comparison: Testing discretion through staff behavior versus trusting safer communication within family.
